description:
*** Please note that this is a HYBRID role, requiring this person to work at our Cottonwood Heights office in SLC two days a week. We are not able to provide work sponsorship (i.e. OPT, STEM-OPT or H-1B visa) for this role *** 

 The Associate Software Engineer is an entry-level role designed to build foundational engineering skills while contributing to impactful software solutions. This role partners with business teams to understand requirements and deliver technology that enhances operations and customer experience. It offers a collaborative, growth-oriented environment where curiosity, initiative, and continuous learning are encouraged.

 Duties & Responsibilities 
· Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications and websites at an entry level.
 · Participate in team-based projects, contributing to planning, coding, and delivery.
 · Apply software engineering best practices and follow established development standards.
 · Document technical designs, processes, and user guides.
 · Provide support and troubleshooting for systems and applications.
 · Engage in peer reviews and knowledge sharing to elevate team capabilities.
 · Train end users or support staff on system functionality as needed.
 
 Qualifications 
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
 · 1–2 years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and training
 
 Competencies 
 Required :
 · Proficiency in at least two of the following: C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET, Salesforce APEX, PHP, T-SQL
 · Strong communication and collaboration skills
 · Self-motivated with a growth mindset and adaptability
 · Ability to present technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences
 · Demonstrates curiosity and initiative in solving problems
 Preferred :
 · Familiarity with: MS SQL Server, SQL, HTML/HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, XML, DOM, AngularJS
 · Exposure to DevOps practices and cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, VSTS)
 · Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies
 

 Work Environment & Physical Requirements 
Performs sedentary work in an office environment with limited lifting (less than 10 pounds) or walking required. Close visual acuity required to perform work at computer terminal. No exposure to adverse environmental conditions. Requires repetitive typing motion, talking, hearing, grasping and feeling.

Disclaimer
 The job description outlines the general nature and scope of work employees perform in this role. It's not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications required for the position. The company reserves the right to modify, revise, or update the job description to meet business needs. 
 
 
 
 
 If you are a current Extra Space employee, please apply through Jobs Hub in Workday. 
 
 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 
 Applications Deadline: Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.
